privacy.notice:
Privacy notice from the {product} bot

When you link this chat to {product}, we store your Telegram user id, chat id and username to deliver notifications and answer your questions. Questions you ask and the answers are logged for the owners and admins of your workspace and deleted after the retention period your workspace sets. We do not keep other message content.

More: /privacy. Disconnect any time: /unlink.
Privacy Policy: {url}
privacy.details: Privacy What we store: your Telegram user id, chat id, username and language; the questions you ask the assistant and its answers (AI query log). Who sees it: owners and admins of your workspace can review the AI query log. Nothing is used to train AI models. How long: the AI query log is deleted after the retention period of your workspace; other message content is not stored. Disconnect: /unlink here or Settings → Integrations in {product}. Privacy Policy: {url}
